title: EtiCor++: Towards Understanding Etiquettical Bias in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs on region-specific social norms using Etiquette Sensitivity (predicting norm acceptability), Region Identification (measuring regional preference and bias scores when mapping etiquettes to regions), Etiquette Generation (assessing alignment and contradictions via NLI), and Odds Ratio analysis for stereotypical term generation.

Using Incremental Option Testing and specific metrics like Preference Score (PS) and Bias For Region Score (BFS) to measure how often LLMs default to or favor high-resource geographical regions (e.g., North America and Europe) over under-represented regions when identifying the origin of specific social etiquettes.
